name: Сільпо
type: Supermarket catalogue and commerce JSON API
whats_there: Full grocery and ready meal catalogue, own brands Премія, Власна Випічка, Повна Чаша. The commerce API sf-ecom-api.silpo.ua exposes search and a detail endpoint per product.
kbzhu_note: GET sf-ecom-api.silpo.ua/v1/uk/branches/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/products/{externalProductId} returns attributeGroups key nutrient with calorie as a kcal/kJ string, plus proteins, fats, carbohydrates per 100 g. Verified live on Яготинське butter, 748/3075. Use the numeric externalProductId, not the UUID id, for this lookup.
access: JSON API, no key, plus HTML site blocked by Cloudflare for curl
size: about 71,600 food items across food relevant categories, from a 28 category commerce search index
license: No license found. Site terms forbid copying without consent.

name: Сільпо MCP server
whats_there: Official MCP endpoint at mcp.silpo.ua/mcp exposing a silpo_get_product_details tool documented to return the full product card, composition, nutritional value, attributes, images.
kbzhu_note: Documentation promises nutrition value but requires OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and apparent AI Factory hackathon registration, so the exact field schema was not confirmed live.
access: MCP over HTTPS, OAuth 2.1, hackathon accounts only
cost_note: Hackathon participants only. Registration closed 2026-09-01, program runs to 2026-09-30.
license: No license found. Docs say all rights reserved.

name: Zakaz.ua

license: zakaz.ua/uk/terms forbids reproduction, copying or reuse without consent.
